findings.reason: the node must also vendor the docs and code question and label data, or scope the port's claim to what it actually makes reproducible, or the port does not supply the reproducibility it is justified by.
findings.text: §7 says the third node ports the §4 and §5 scripts into a repo module "so its figures reproduce from a checkout", yet §4's measurement (line 222) reads its questions and labels from `~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/imas-codex/search-rerank-prototype/{queries,labels}.json`, outside the repository, so a ported script still cannot reproduce §4's figure from a checkout
